subject: Fresh blind review of audit methodology v6

payload.mission: Review the audit methodology itself. Do not audit or remediate the Anti-Hallucination Protocol implementation in this pass.

do_not_consume_before_provisional_findin: prior model conclusions about methodology v6
conversation summaries of what the primary agent thinks is wrong or right with v6
allowed_before_provisional_findings: repository structure required to understand references and boundaries

review_questions: Does AUDIT-METHODOLOGY/** cleanly separate audit control-plane instructions from AUDITS/** evidence/history?
Does the blind phase actually prevent prior-evidence contamination, including external-audits and other historical channels?
Are CURRENT_MAIN, RELEASE_TAG and EXACT_COMMIT target modes precise and non-conflicting?
Does discover-first baseline logic avoid stale hardcoded commands without giving the audited repository authority to rewrite the audit mission?
Are untrusted-target-content rules strong enough to keep repository text in the data plane?
Does the threat-model/severity scheme properly distinguish ordinary-path failures, caller-controlled input, environment failure and local-write tamper?
Is self-test diagnostic evidence cleanly separated from independent behavioral evaluation?
Does BEHAVIORAL-EVALUATION-PROTOCOL.md define a defensible randomized/blind A/B path without treating humans or model judges as truth oracles?
Is REPORT-CONTRACT.md sufficient for loss-minimized machine ingestion into external audit infrastructure?
Can fixed minimum counts, required sections or wording create quantity gaming, audit theatre or incentives to fabricate low-value probes?
Can methodology-history material prime an auditor even though the live canonical prompt is separated?
Are there circular dependencies where the methodology relies on claims that only the methodology itself validates?
Are there ambiguous or contradictory instructions across the five methodology files?
Could a future version of AHP silently invalidate assumptions in v6 methodology?
Is the migration pointer under AUDITS/** safe and unambiguous?
payload.adversarial_requirement: Assume methodology v6 may be sophisticated audit theatre. Try to falsify its claims of blindness, independence, reproducibility, scope discipline, evidence separation and future-proofing.
payload.quality_rule: Do not manufacture findings to satisfy a quota. One precise reproduced contradiction outranks many stylistic observations.
payload.user_visible_completion: After durable files and the RESULT message are successfully written, tell the user only a concise summary of your verdict and findings. End with exactly: Możesz teraz napisać Gniewce: Sol skończyła.
payload.failure_behavior: If you cannot write any required artifact or RESULT message, say exactly what failed. Do not claim completion and do not tell the user to say 'Sol skończyła'.
